│ stages    this session's files only                                                                                        │
│ push      no                                                                                                               │

· switch · switching back is the way back
╭─ Approve tool ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── ⚠ low ─╮
│ $ switch to topic                                                                                                          │
│ ⚠ low · nothing it reports is open                                                                                         │
│ switch to the branch topic                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                            │
│ stages    this session's files only                                                                                        │
│ push      no                                                                                                               │
│ undo      git switch - — the tree becomes the other branch's, and every file this session had read is re-read              │
